usedFor: Evoliz holds clients and invoices, and Conversion Chats messages them when “New Client” runs “Send Template Message”.

bestTemplate.name: “New Client” in Evoliz, then “Send Template Message” in Conversion Chats
bestTemplate.why: A new client gets a template message through your Conversion Chats account, so the first contact is consistent.

watchOut: “New Client” in Evoliz is polling and also returns updated clients, so the same client can be messaged twice.
